items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Gee, Bill Davis and these guys, they got it made now.

ctx.x: Ha-ha, they didn't know. They said, 'It's an organ' -- so they want you to do organ, you know. The only places that had an organ was Eddie Randall(?) in Switzerland, because you know, they were available. But in other places they didn't know what a Hammond organ was! Gee, Bill Davis and these guys, they got it made now. It was really hard in those days.
